name: Mikage Yuka
source:
"T, Thank you so much...... [url=/c136409]Sensei[/url], I'll cherish it for the rest of my life......!"

A young girl who lives next door to the Kuroneko café. With her busy parents often away, Yuka finds a daytime haven at the café, entrusted to the staff's care.

Being a kid of the digital age, Yuka spends her time reading books and [i]manga[/i] on her smartphone and tablet. She's head over heels for Akira's debut work and has a few copies lying around—one for keeps and the rest for sharing with her pals.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara08.html]official website[/url]]
